value.body:
I believe every individual and organization has a “why”.
In this portfolio, my 'why' is built through the 'fertilizer' of daily work—from my experience in Engineering to Administration, where I found my deep interest in people. This led me to HR People Operations and Employer Branding, where I build L&D programs for the organization, while growing alongside it every single day. My focus is to make today’s contributions meaningful for the future, and I am committed to making my cross-functional background my greatest strength on this career path. Thank you for visiting my garden of continuous growth. I hope you enjoy exploring, and I would be so happy to collaborate!
— Nadya.

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: People-first People Operations Specialist with a Tech & Analytical Agility background, dedicated to bridging people, culture, and branding while specializing in Strategic HR, Culture Enablement, Employee Experience, and Talent Ecosystems Driven by continuous adaptation and proactive initiatives to shape Organizational Development, designing 4-tier talent lifecycles, peer-to-peer upskilling, 1-on-1 mentoring for 100+ personnel, and high-impact L&D programs. Pioneered Employer Branding and well-being initiatives, while maintaining organized HR systems and building a centralized internal HRIS platform to cut manual bureaucracy by 85% and embedding strategic EVP across Talent Management, remaining adaptable to align people strategies with long-term organizational goals.

bullets: Initiated and led the end-to-end development of a multi-functional HRIS platform to centralize core HR operations and remote monitoring, cutting manual bureaucracy by 95% through HR workflow automation.

Co-designed workplace culture and HR systems by bridging internal rules with Gen Z preferences through structured Flexible Working Arrangements (FWA) and standardized communication protocols, establishing team accountability and foundational work policies.
Managed end-to-end talent acquisition for 100+ applicants and pioneered a KSA-based assessment framework, improving recruitment system effectiveness and role-fit alignment with organizational needs.

Designed and implemented an end-to-end 4-tier Talent Lifecycle framework (Attraction, Engagement, Development, Regeneration), laying the foundation for a sustainable talent ecosystem and driving long-term organizational growth.

Spearheaded a 4-session Learning & Development program for 30+ candidates and 15 mentors aligned with organizational skill-mapping; secured a 93% satisfaction rate (4.51/5.00 overall score), peaking at 4.59/5.00 specifically for learning value-add.

Embedded the Employer Value Proposition (EVP) across the entire talent lifecycle from structured orientation and onboarding to seamless offboarding, achieving a 90% satisfaction rate and fostering strong organizational commitment.
Applied a methodical problem-solving approach in 1-on-1 mentoring sessions with 80+ research assistants, resolving individual concerns and team dynamics to achieve a 93% talent retention rate.

Strengthened employer branding initiatives through university talent attraction programs under the 'Golden Gate Candidate' initiative, leveraging strong campus relations to attract 200+ student applicants while delivering a high-quality candidate experience for early-career talent.
entries.heading: Staff Administrator - People Operations & Employer Branding
entries.description: My non-traditional background became my greatest strength. Building on a solid foundation, I now let strategic initiatives act as fertilizer, from automating HRIS workflows to designing 4-tier talent lifecycle frameworks, leading L&D programs, mentoring 80+ researchers to sustain a 93% retention rate, and delivering meaningful impact wherever I stand.

bullets: Leveraged strong documentation expertise to manage operational workflows across 10+ concurrent projects (3–5 handled daily), maintaining document accuracy and confidentiality to achieve full compliance and deliver final project reports to key stakeholders.

Managed digital filing and HR database systems for 70+ research assistants using Microsoft Office and OneDrive, establishing a structured database for contracts, attendance, and leave records that optimized daily operations.

Coordinated cross-functional alignment between internal teams and 5+ external stakeholders, preparing visual presentation decks to facilitate meeting agendas, field testing updates, and final report delivery.

Organized development and training programs for 20+ of the organization’s personnel, successfully aligning research capabilities with current skill demands and emerging AI tools for organization’s personnel.

Pioneered the organization’s employer branding from scratch by establishing brand guidelines and producing 100+ high-impact visuals, videos, and animations, translating complex technical research to elevate organizational visibility and talent attraction.

Spearheaded a social media team of 10 research assistants to execute 300+ social media assets through strategic branding, standardizing brand identity across 15+ research projects to maximize audience engagement.
entries.heading: Research Assistant – Project Administrator, Social Media and Publications
entries.description: Watered through daily hands-on practice. Entrusted with human-centered responsibilities and working closely with research students unlocked my true calling in People & Culture, Organizational Development, and People Analytics. I realized my engineering discipline wasn't lost, it was a unique cross-functional strength.

bullets: Co-developed an end-to-end sensory system with PT Pindad to analyze human-centric comfort and safety metrics; co-authored 1 published research paper and registered 3 Intellectual Properties (Patent, Copyright, Industrial Design) on human-factor evaluation and workplace wellbeing.

Collaborated with a cross-functional team of 10+ research assistants on system troubleshooting and alignment across 5+ military field trials, delivering strategic progress reports that enhanced stakeholder trust and maintained a strategic alliance with PT Pindad.

Analyzed and cleaned 60,000+ raw data points using Excel and MATLAB to model passenger dynamics, leveraging data-driven visualizations to evaluate potential safety and comfort impacts on personnel in high-risk environments.
entries.heading: Research and Development Engineer
entries.description: Where it all began. Working on the technical side organically led me to a major revelation: no matter how advanced the technology, human talent is always the key. This phase built my solid analytical mindset and comfort with technology, the roots I still carry today.

entries.heading: Early Seeds: The Rooted Origin
entries.description: It started in childhood with a dream to teach, which naturally evolved in high school as I became everyone’s go-to confidante, sparking a strong desire to study psychology. Looking back, this was my very first realization that my true 'why' lies in understanding people and helping them grow.

recipe.text: Talent Attraction: Spearheaded Open Mind 2025, attracting 250+ registrants.

Interactive On-Site Engagement: Designed and initiated a "Golden Gate" discussion-first booth experience at Open Mind 2025, serving as a space for in-depth discussions that allowed participants to explore CoE STAS-RG more deeply.

Pipeline Nurturing: Captured early sign-ups via an Interest Form, onboarded candidates into a centralized Talent Pool Database, and granted them exclusive "Golden Candidate" status with special privileges.

points: Exclusive WA Group Community: Enabled direct, in-depth interactions and discussions with CoE STAS-RG admins, fostering a sense of exclusivity and belonging.
Priority Recruitment Access: Granted early access to recruitment announcements prior to public releases (successfully deployed for the February 2026 hiring wave).
Targeted Training Opportunities: Delivered tailored skill-building programs based on student interest areas.

results.text: Established an exclusive talent pool with a 40% interest rate.
Designed an End-to-End Talent Lifecycle Framework: Attraction – Engagement – Development – Regeneration.
Laid the foundation for a Sustainable Talent Ecosystem at CoE STAS-RG.

chefNotes.background: Limited student involvement in key pillar projects due to short graduation timelines (1–2 years max), creating challenges in sustaining the continuity of ongoing and future research projects.
chefNotes.philosophy: A talent attraction event does not end on the day it happens; it can serve as the foundation for building a regeneration system that sustains organizational continuity. This experience taught me to view events not merely as standalone activities, but as strategic investments with long-term impact.

value.name: 30+ Conversations, 4 Talent Stage, 1 Single Day: Navigating Full-Spectrum People Operations

recipe.text: 🌱 The Seedlings (Onboarding): Allocated morning hours for high school interns to review their first-week progress, check in on well-being, and organizational compliance management.
🎓 The Harvest (Offboarding): Transitioned midday to guide graduating research students through Web HRIS administrative clearances for a smooth exit experience.
🔍 The Selection (Talent Attraction): Dedicated afternoon slots to align recruitment pipelines and review interview evaluation insights with the hiring team.

🌙 The Ecosystem Alignment (Culture & EVP): Wrapped up the evening with an interactive group session for 30+ research students to align on culture, share updates, and genuinely listen to their experiences.

results.text: Operational Execution: Successfully delivered tailored touchpoints across 4 lifecycle stages and 30+ talents in just one day.
Context-Switching: Proved the ability to pivot mindsets instantly, ensuring the right message reached the right person at the right time.
Learning by Doing with a Full Heart: Turned a draining, high-intensity sprint into the ultimate hands-on masterclass, reinforcing my deep passion for building a human-centered ecosystem.

chefNotes.background: People Operations is never "one-size-fits-all." The real test was mastering rapid context-switching: delivering 4 entirely different employee lifecycle stages to 30+ talents within a single 12-hour window. I needed to ensure that every individual received the exact message and empathetic support tailored to their specific phase, without losing operational focus.
chefNotes.philosophy: I learned (📝) that this work requires high adaptability, active listening, and seamless context-switching. Beyond the processes, it’s about holding space for people at every phase of their journey.
